title: Google DeepMind and Singapore Government collaborate to build fine-tuned AI model for scam detection
hook_text: Singapore is blocking scams using AI
script:
Scam victims in Singapore lost four billion dollars since twenty nineteen.
Google DeepMind is now collaborating with the Singapore government to tackle this issue.
They are developing advanced AI models to identify and block fraudulent conversational patterns.
The project uses on-device technology to prioritize user privacy and data security.
This initiative aims to protect citizens from increasingly sophisticated digital phishing attempts.
Google DeepMind expects these tools to identify threats before they reach the user.
Would you rely on on-device AI to filter your private messages for scams?

editor.one_line: Strong, factual reporting, but visual variety is lacking and feels repetitive.
script_fixes: LINE 3: Change 'advanced AI models' to 'lightweight Gemma models' to be more specific.
LINE 5: Change 'This initiative aims to' to 'The collaboration aims to' to avoid filler.
visual_notes: line 1: The same abstract graphic is held for too long across multiple frames.
line 2: The abstract graphic is reused again, creating visual fatigue.
line 4: The visual is just text on a plain background; needs a relevant icon or diagram.
line 6: The Google logo is generic; show a visual representation of on-device processing.
